thread:
Anya: Quick flag — after the runtime deploy this morning we have a perf regression on Mixtral configs. p95 token latency up ~18% for long seqs (>=2048) and KV cache hit-rate dropped ~12% on our multi-turn workloads. A few evals failing (coherency/hallucination spike). Anyone looking?
Sam: Which kernel swap went out with that deploy? I think we flipped the auto-selector to prefer tiled-attn-v2 for high-head models.
Anya: Correct — auto-selector rule changed to prefer tiled-attn-v2 when heads>=32 && kv_dim==128. Rollout id: deploy-20280314-runtime-tiling. Profiling snapshot pasted below.
Anya: ```
# profile summary (canary-03)
total_tokens: 1_200_000
attention_kernel_tiled_v2: 42.3s  (+26% vs baseline)
attention_kernel_legacy: 30.1s
kv_cache_copy: 18.2s  (+40%)
rope_apply: 6.8s  (+9%)
other: 12.4s
```
Matt: Hmm. KV copy up that much is worrying. Is tiled-v2 doing a different layout (interleaved QKV) causing more copies? Or are we materializing caches earlier?
Rachel: We also toggled RoPE scaling for Mixtral in PR #458 (linear -> scaled_rope) to better handle long contexts. That changes positional multipliers; might change key similarity. Could be why cache hit rate dropped.
Priya: Also FYI the deploy flipped a quantization toggle to q4_0 on a subset of instances for memory headroom. Some kernels pick different codepaths when quantized.
Sam: Two working hypotheses: 1) tiled-attn-v2 + scaled RoPE leads to fp pattern divergence -> eval diffs. 2) KV layout + quantization causes lazy-copy to fallback to a slower path -> latency hit and cache miss behavior. We should run a small combinatorial matrix.
Anya: I ran a short matrix locally. TL;DR: legacy kernel + scaled_rope + fp16 -> baseline. tiled-v2 + scaled_rope + q4_0 -> worst (p95 +22%, eval regressions 6/200 prompts). Metrics below.
Anya: ```
matrix results (short run)
- legacy | linear_rope | fp16: p95 120ms, eval_fail 2/200
- legacy | scaled_rope | fp16: p95 125ms, eval_fail 3/200
- tiled-v2 | linear_rope | fp16: p95 140ms, eval_fail 4/200
- tiled-v2 | scaled_rope | q4_0: p95 155ms, eval_fail 6/200
```
InfraBot: Deploybot: rollback scheduled for deploy-20280314-runtime-tiling. Initiated by Anya.
Matt: Before we full rollback, can we push a quick runtime patch to the kernel auto-selector: prefer legacy when heads>=32 OR when quant_mode==q4_0? That avoids a full revert and buys time.
Priya: +1. Also suggest a canary rule: only enable tiled-v2 for seq_len < 1024 until we diagnose long-seq behavior.
Rachel: I'll open a PR to revert scaled_rope for Mixtral in the canary pool and will run a deterministic eval diff. I'll also run a KV-layout comparator to see if keys/hash diverge.
Anya: Plan: (1) infra rollback to restore p95, (2) quick selector patch (Matt) to avoid tiled-v2 on quantized/high-head cases, (3) deterministic eval matrix on 50k prompts (Rachel/Priya), (4) postmortem + action items. I'll update this thread in ~30m after rollback.
Sam: Ping me when you have the flamegraphs — I have traces from the canaries and can correlate kernel latencies to the seq distribution.
Anya: Thanks all — appreciate the fast triage. Going to coordinate rollback now. :thumbsup:
